description: The browser write-and-publish infrastructure: Decap CMS at /admin, the two Vercel serverless GitHub OAuth functions at /api, the Vercel + GitHub Actions build config, and PUBLISHING.md. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs the buildable root and _config.yml excluding api/ and public/). Independent of FEAT-002's page rendering — it adds separate files and config. Its runtime behavior (OAuth handshake, Actions build, preview 302) is Tier B and verified only after a later push + the user's one-time setup; this feature is gated only by file-shape/static Tier-A checks.
steps: Create $WT/admin/index.html per §12.1: minimal HTML head + a <script src> loading Decap from unpkg, pinned to a concrete known-good decap-cms@3.x version (not a bare ^3.0.0 range) — review NIT-5.

Create $WT/admin/config.yml per §12.2: backend { name: github, repo: benjaminmanoj/benmanoj, branch: main, base_url: https://www.benmanoj.com, auth_endpoint: api/auth }; NO media_folder/public_folder; collections -> one 'papers' collection { label Papers, folder _papers, create: true, extension: md, format: frontmatter, slug: '{{year}}-{{month}}-{{day}}-{{slug}}' } with fields title (string), date (datetime, format YYYY-MM-DD, date_format YYYY-MM-DD, time_format false), body (markdown).

Create $WT/api/auth.js per §13.1 (module.exports = (req,res)=>{...}): generate random state, 302-redirect to https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize with client_id from process.env.OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID, scope=repo, redirect_uri=https://www.benmanoj.com/api/callback, state; if OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID missing respond 500 'OAuth not configured' and log the missing-env name only (never the value).

Create $WT/api/callback.js per §13.2 (module.exports = (req,res)=>{...}): read code (400 'Missing code' if absent); POST to https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token with client_id, client_secret from process.env.OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET, code, redirect_uri, Accept: application/json using global fetch; on success return HTML whose inline script posts authorizing:github then authorization:github:success:{"token":"<token>","provider":"github"} to window.opener, targeting ONLY the single origin https://www.benmanoj.com (never '*'), failing safe (no token) on origin mismatch; on error post authorization:github:error:<message>. Never log the secret.

Create $WT/vercel.json per §11.1 (primary path): buildCommand '', outputDirectory '_site', NO functions key, redirects rule 308-ing any Host benmanoj.com request to https://www.benmanoj.com/$1 (permanent: true).

Create $WT/.github/workflows/build.yml per §11.1: on push to main with paths-ignore ['_site/**'], permissions contents: write, concurrency group, actions/checkout@v4, ruby/setup-ruby@v1 with ruby-version '3.3' and bundler-cache true, run bundle exec jekyll build, then a step that git add _site and commits only when the diff is non-empty, then git push.

Create $WT/PUBLISHING.md per §15: what-this-is; day-to-day (open https://www.benmanoj.com/admin/, log in, New -> Papers -> Title/Date/Body -> Publish); one-time GitHub OAuth App setup (Homepage https://www.benmanoj.com, Authorization callback URL https://www.benmanoj.com/api/callback, copy Client ID, generate Client Secret, set OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID/OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET in Vercel -> redeploy); exact Vercel settings (root directory = repo root, empty build command/'Other' preset, output dir _site, env var names); the always-use-www note + apex->www redirect; the going-live scope boundary (loop live only after push + setup); Writing/About edited as HTML; local preview (bundle install + bundle exec jekyll serve); the notebook-grid tradeoff; the Crayonia FFP personal-use-only license note; and the /api/auth 404 recovery (review MEDIUM-1: add fully-qualified functions.runtime @vercel/node@3.2.0 to vercel.json if a preview 404s).
acceptance_criteria: admin/config.yml declares backend.name github, repo benjaminmanoj/benmanoj, branch main, base_url https://www.benmanoj.com, no media_folder/public_folder, and a papers collection writing to _papers with extension md, format frontmatter, and fields title (string), date (datetime YYYY-MM-DD), body (markdown).
api/auth.js 302-redirects to github.com/login/oauth/authorize with client_id from OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID, redirect_uri https://www.benmanoj.com/api/callback, scope=repo.

api/callback.js exchanges code using OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID + OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET and returns HTML doing the authorizing:github -> authorization:github:success handshake posting only to https://www.benmanoj.com; the client secret appears in no committed file other than as a process.env read and in no served response body.
vercel.json sets outputDirectory _site, has NO functions key, empty buildCommand, and the apex->www redirects rule; build.yml pins Ruby 3.3, builds Jekyll, and guards against a commit loop.
PUBLISHING.md documents the day-to-day loop, the one-time OAuth setup (callback URL + env var names), exact Vercel settings, the www/apex note, and the scope boundary.
verification: Syntax-check the two functions: if node is available (NOTE: node was NOT on PATH during exploration), run node --check api/auth.js and api/callback.js; otherwise `ruby -rjson` cannot parse JS, so confirm balanced braces/parens and required literals by reading the files — state in findings whether node was available.

ruby -ryaml validates admin/config.yml with the required backend + collection fields; ruby -ryaml validates .github/workflows/build.yml; ruby -rjson validates vercel.json and confirms outputDirectory=_site, no functions key, redirects present.

grep confirms api/auth.js has OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID, scope=repo, /api/callback; api/callback.js has OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET, authorization:github:success, www.benmanoj.com and never '*'; grep for client_secret in api/auth.js returns nothing.

grep confirms PUBLISHING.md contains api/callback, both env var names, www.benmanoj.com/admin, and _site. NOTE: /api/auth 302 on a preview and the live Decap handshake are Tier B — cannot be e2e tested without the user's OAuth credentials + a deploy; state this in findings.
findings:
Implemented all FEAT-003 files in the worktree: admin/index.html (Decap loaded from unpkg, pinned to the concrete known-good decap-cms@3.8.3 with verified dist/decap-cms.js path per NIT-5, not a bare ^3.0.0 range), admin/config.yml, api/auth.js, api/callback.js, vercel.json, .github/workflows/build.yml, and PUBLISHING.md. No changes made outside FEAT-003's scope.

Tier-A verification (all PASS):
- ruby -rjson parsed vercel.json: outputDirectory="_site", buildCommand="", NO functions key, redirects present with destination https://www.benmanoj.com/$1 and permanent:true (308 apex->www).
- ruby -ryaml parsed admin/config.yml: backend.name=github, repo=benjaminmanoj/benmanoj, branch=main, base_url=https://www.benmanoj.com, auth_endpoint=api/auth, NO media_folder/public_folder, papers collection -> folder _papers, create:true, extension:md, format:frontmatter, slug {{year}}-{{month}}-{{day}}-{{slug}}, fields title/string, date/datetime (format+date_format YYYY-MM-DD, time_format false), body/markdown.
- ruby -ryaml parsed .github/workflows/build.yml: ruby-version '3.3', bundler-cache true, permissions contents:write, concurrency group, paths-ignore ['_site/**'], checkout@v4 + setup-ruby@v1, bundle exec jekyll build, and the commit-loop guard (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit) then git push.
- grep: api/auth.js contains OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID, scope='repo', /api/callback redirect_uri, login/oauth/authorize, 302; auth.js contains NO client_secret/CLIENT_SECRET reference.
- grep: api/callback.js contains OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET, authorizing:github, authorization:github:success, access_token exchange, and targets ONLY https://www.benmanoj.com (no '*' wildcard postMessage). The client secret is read ONLY via process.env.OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET (line 59); the only other occurrence is the env-var NAME in an error log string (never the value) and it appears in no served response body.
- grep: PUBLISHING.md documents api/callback, both env var names, https://www.benmanoj.com/admin, _site, the day-to-day loop, one-time OAuth App setup (Homepage + callback URL + env vars + redeploy), exact Vercel settings, www/apex redirect note, scope boundary, Writing/About-as-HTML, local preview, notebook-grid tradeoff, Crayonia FFP license, and the MEDIUM-1 /api/auth 404 fallback (fully-qualified functions.runtime @vercel/node@3.2.0).

node was NOT on PATH during verification, so node --check could not run; the two serverless functions were instead verified by reading plus a ruby balanced-delimiter check (braces/parens/brackets all balance to 0 in both files) and the required-literal greps above, exactly as the FEAT-003 verification fallback specifies.

Tier B (NOT gated here, cannot be e2e tested locally): the /api/auth 302 redirect on a Vercel preview and the full Decap authorizing:github -> authorization:github:success OAuth handshake, plus the GitHub Actions build that produces/commits _site/. These require the user's one-time GitHub OAuth App credentials (OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID/SECRET set in Vercel) and a deploy/push, both out of scope for this workflow. No local Jekyll build was run (local Ruby is 2.6.10, below Jekyll 4.3's >=2.7 requirement; no version manager/Homebrew/Docker) and none was fabricated; FEAT-003 is static file-shape work gated on Tier-A checks only. No build artifacts (_site/, .jekyll-cache/, vendor/, Gemfile.lock) were produced, so none needed cleanup before commit.
